title: ALL ( column ) as a table includes the blank row added for orphans

source.quote: In every case, ALL includes in the result the additional blank row generated for invalid relationships
source.supports: ALL includes the blank row generated for an invalid relationship

source.quote: ALL considers the blank row as valid.
source.supports: ALL treats the blank row as a valid row

derivation: Product[Color] holds Red, Blue, Red. Sales rows 3 and 4 have ProductKey 9, which Product lacks, so Product has the blank row and ALL returns its BLANK color too.
